PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Visual Programming.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Visual Programming.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Visual Programming.
